text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so none of the fixes have been run. I checked each one by reading the code against the tests.

- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the policy comment and the tests.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm the whole suite passes.
